name: Italian Brainrot Thieves 🧠
desc:
Welcome to Italian Brainrot Thieves!

Purchase Italian Brainrots and generate cash, or steal Brainrots from other players and grow even quicker!

When you grow big enough, rebirth to expand your base and unlock new items.

Like the game and join the group for +10% more cash!
Premium players get +15% extra cash!
Get +5% cash for each friend you invite!
